markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Vance holds the strongest position in the 2028 presidential market at 24.6% due to his role as sitting vice president, consistent leads in Republican primary polling around 35-45%, and alignment with the party's base following the prior election cycle. Marco Rubio trails as a secondary GOP option at 8.8% on the strength of his Cabinet experience and rising visibility. The Democratic side remains fragmented, with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 13.3%, Jon Ossoff at 11.8%, Gavin Newsom at 7.1%, and Kamala Harris at 3.6% reflecting shifting early primary preferences among progressives, governors, and senators amid a wide field. Trader consensus prices in high uncertainty ahead of 2026 midterms and formal announcements, with support likely to consolidate around frontrunners once primary dynamics clarify.
